description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single-target Dark/Poison/NE magical attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode] & Crystal Force Mode: Kefka (Dark) to the user
Crystal Force I/II: Single-target overflow Dark/Poison/NE magic attack (34.60 each) capped at 199999; Crystal Force II: Grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Magical 30% Boost 2], [50% DEF/RES Pierce 2], & [200% ATB 1] to user; After using Crystal Force II, chases with 8 single-target Dark/Poison/NE magic attack (3.05 each)

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00
